_comment: Golden tasks for core/skills/codify/SKILL.md. TWO bound cases, both load-bearing and both against
the skill's OWN OUTPUT — proposals, which its step 4 names: step 1 wants provenance on them and
step 3 wants an enforcement field. core/templates/proposal.md mandates both and nothing checks
either, so neither has a carrier.
This _comment claimed step 1 was `bound TWICE`, to proposals and to memory. There is no memory
binding in this file: the memory-provenance row was dropped when the pre-commit checkpoint bound
step 3 instead, and the summary did not move with it. Copilot round 1 on #360.

mandate.quote: Name the incident and link it.

_note: CODIFY'S OWN OUTPUT IS A PROPOSAL — its step 4 says so — and core/templates/proposal.md mandates
a Provenance field. `doctor` checks provenance on MEMORY records; docs.sh checks a proposal's
numbering, its outcome and its pull-request URL. Neither checks a proposal's provenance. So this
row has no carrier and it is the corpus's second live finding.
THE PREDICATE IS SHAPE-TOLERANT ON PURPOSE. The corpus carries two spellings — `**Provenance.**`
(14) and `## Provenance` (13) — and a literal predicate would report the thirteen renamed ones as
absent. That is exactly the false red this session's own first measurement produced against the
task corpus, caught at a checkpoint. Six files carry neither spelling and those are the finding.

cases.why: The right altitude — core, a pack, or the workspace — is the judgement this step exists to exercise. A rule's altitude is visible in where the file sits, but whether that was the RIGHT altitude is not a fact any artifact carries.

_note: BOUND AT THE PRE-COMMIT CHECKPOINT, which refused the judgement-only classification this
step first carried. The declined argument was that presence-checking would be `the
presence floor with none of the value` — an argument this module refutes in its own
printed output, and which equally refutes the provenance binding beside it.
core/templates/proposal.md mandates an **Enforcement.** field and nothing checks it.
THIRTEEN of thirty-three carry none — a larger finding than the six that shipped first.

cases.why: A proposal naming the pull request that filed it IS checked — by docs.sh, in bash, with the URL pattern inline. Binding it here would put two spellings of one rule across a LANGUAGE boundary, which is worse than the same-language duplication evals/README.md already refuses for the awk filter. The carrier exists and is not this one.
